name: Minimal Tiptap Editor
summary: Rich text editor component for shadcn/ui built on Tiptap, with a configurable toolbar and image upload support.
description: A lightweight WYSIWYG rich text editor component built on Tiptap and styled for shadcn/ui projects. It installs from the shadcn registry or manually with the listed dependencies, and ships React and Tailwind source: configurable toolbar, image support with upload and error management, and documented props for customization. Demo at minimal-tiptap.aslamh.dev; the repo was renamed from shadcn-minimal-tiptap to minimal-tiptap.
